summary: Completed the analyzer-only P0 follow-up to the 2026-09-30 DXVK HMD performance failure. R23 pipeline cadence is split into pure MENU, pure GAMEPLAY, and MIXED_OR_UNKNOWN windows; mixed transition windows are excluded from phase averages, the legacy all-window XR-Hz remains compatibility-only, and repeated pure-gameplay cadence >=1.5x display period emits DXVK_GAMEPLAY_CADENCE_DEGRADED. No renderer, transport, cadence-control, copy, or OpenXR runtime policy changed.
